newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telesp 8-mo gross receipts 3.103 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Telesp 8-mo gross receipts 3.103 bln reais.

text.p: Brazilian state telecom Telesp said it raked in 3.103 billion reais in gross operating receipts in the first eight months of 1996 jumping from 1.872 billion reais in the same period last year.

In a statement to Brazilian stock markets, Telesp, a unit of federally owned Telebras serving Sao Paulo state, said gross profits in the period hit 1.13 billion reais versus 626 million in January-August 1995.
Earlier on Tuesday, the company reported a net profit of 511 million reais for the period, up sharply from 148 million reais in January-August 1995.
A Telesp spokeswoman also said net operating revenues reached 2.3 billion reais in January-August versus 1.39 billion reais a year earlier.
In its statement, Telesp said installed standard phone lines rose to 4,737,354 by August's end versus 4,336,889 by the same eight-month period last year, the firm said.
Cellular terminals rose to 564,400 versus 387,000 in August 1995, it said.
Telesp is Telebras's largest subsidiary. It is expected to be privatized, along with the rest of the Telebras system, in coming years.
